question: What should I practice for my shooting arm?
fixture: one synthetic shot, no supported personal association, no video

response.message: Use one focus for this practice set so you can tell what feels different.
response.cue: Lift the ball with your shooting hand underneath and let the arm extend toward the basket.
response.explanation: Give the ball a repeatable lift.

practice.title: Close one-hand form shots
practice.instructions: Take a short set close to the rim, then add your guide hand.
practice.evaluation: Compare the shooting arm at similar points in each clip.

knowledge_references.source: Jr. NBA — At Home shooting drills
